releases.body:
Improves backend-aware GPT Image tools for OpenCode 1 and 2.

- Makes Sub2API async mode and submission timeout plugin-only configuration; tool descriptions, progress, results, and recovery errors expose the execution mode and accepted task ID.
- Sends Codex count, size, quality, and background to the Images endpoint on a best-effort basis, with notices when returned values differ or cannot be verified.
- Narrows Codex tool parameters, preserves actual image formats, and avoids automatic paid resubmissions.

See the [README](https://github.com/hlhr202/opencode2-gpt-image#readme) for configuration. Real proxy and Codex end-to-end behavior remains unverified.

First stable release of opencode2-gpt-image.

- Supports OpenCode 1.18.29+ and OpenCode 2.
- Generates and edits images through Sub2API, CLIProxyAPI, and compatible Images APIs using official OpenAI image model IDs.
- Supports Sub2API async tasks and resuming by task ID.
- Provides an opt-in, best-effort Codex backend.

Install and configuration: see the [README](https://github.com/hlhr202/opencode2-gpt-image#readme). Real proxy end-to-end compatibility has not yet been verified.
